biography.value: Tempest Lords are authority figures among Air Nephilim — they communicate in complete sentences, evaluate the battlefield intelligently, and will offer tactical observations whether asked or not. The Vortex Aura keeps enemies constantly displaced, Lightning Lance clears lines, and Tempest Blow at Margin 2 sends targets flying far enough to take falling damage against walls or off ledges. A summoner who briefs one on the full situation rather than just issuing target instructions will find it performs significantly better — Tempest Lords do things with context that they cannot do without it.

system.attacksNotes:
Tempest Blow [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 6), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 12 damage (7 + 5 Str) + 4 lightning damage (Half DR); target pushed 20 feet.
  • Margin 2: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 lightning damage; pushed 20 feet + Stunned until end of their next turn + knocked Prone; no save.
  • Margin 3: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 lightning damage + Stunned + Prone; all creatures within 15 feet of target take 8 lightning damage and are pushed 10 feet from the shockwave.

Lightning Lance [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 4 + Ranged Combat 5), Range: 100 ft, 5-foot-wide line.

  • Margin 1:: 16 lightning damage (12 + 4 Dex) + Dazed.
  • Margin 2: 16 lightning damage, DR halved (round up) + Stunned until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 16 lightning damage, DR halved (round up) + Stunned + Deafened for 1 minute.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Vortex Aura: Creatures starting their turn within 20 feet make a Fortitude [Easy] save or pushed 10 feet directly away. Ranged ### Attacks passing through the aura area add 1 to both dice. Powerful Build: The Tempest Lord counts as Gargantuan for carrying, pushing, dragging, and lifting. Momentum: When the Tempest Lord moves at least 20 feet before making a melee attack, subtract 1 from both attack dice on that attack Intimidating Presence: As a [Combat] action all creatures within 40 feet that can hear it make a Will [Hard] save. On failure: target gains the Frightened condition for 1 minute. Creatures immune to fear are unaffected. Resilient Defense (2/day): When the Tempest Lord fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
